call_purpose: You wanted to find out why your customers were not receiving the order confirmation email after buying.

resolved.text: We switched on the order confirmation email for your product, and you confirmed the email arrived in your inbox after your test order.

covered.text: We explained that the email still shows the default sender name, and that you can change it under Email settings, Sender name.

customer_next_steps.text: Change the sender name to your brand name.
